_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/targets/test_spell_or_creature_target.py. t_soc_bounce is Fatehold Charm's bounce mode on its own: one spell_or_permanent target whose permanent_selector narrows only the permanent half. t_soc_wide is the near miss, the same clause written as one selector, which makes it 'target creature spell or creature'.
